entities.summary: Great Seljuk, a notable figure in the history of Azerbaijan, associated with Seljuk and Atabeg Period (1075–1136). Preceded by Seljuk Turkification. Their legacy influenced Eldiguzid capital Tabriz becomes a major commercial and cultural center and Eldiguzid.
